propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra, every route's possible capability name exists, and no probe imports optional packages.

Execution boundaries must invoke capability guards only after existing handlers/factories parse the selected mode/backend, not during route discovery, to preserve stable verbs and lean diagnostic paths.

For error postures, a shared error helper raises OptionalDependencyError at the selected boundary; for unavailable/abstain/fallback postures, domain components retain control of result payloads and logging.
Stable commands and top-level help must remain present in a no-extras wheel, with capability guards enforced only at mode/provider selection boundaries (e.g., audit serve, Bedrock construction).
Separate entry points mcp_server and review_bot must consume capability metadata without appearing in the top-level CLI route registry.
